name: Workspace Manager Dialog
description: Edits Workspace identity and its primary Project Folder through the shared Workbench resource-form structure.

states: Open Manage Workspace from a Workspace ellipsis or context menu and inspect name and primary Folder fields.
Change the primary Folder and confirm that the modal keeps the established cancel and save behavior.

useWhen: A person needs to rename one Workspace or change which Project Folder supplies its default launch CWD.
The editable fields belong to one Workspace while the available Folder choices come from its owning Project.
avoidWhen: Folder membership itself changes; use the Project manager dialog owned by the Project.
The operation creates, duplicates, or removes a Workspace and does not require editable resource fields.
invariants: The selected primary Folder must remain a member of the Workspace's owning Project.
Removing the selected Folder falls back to the next Project Folder without prompting for a replacement.
Cancel commits neither the name draft nor the primary Folder draft.
